reason: Primary purpose is an automation-focused DeepSeek Harness plugin for conversation state management: it lets users rewind/restore chat turns via UI controls and optionally revert workspace files when continuing from a rewind point, using background session and snapshot operations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话中提供时间线式回退与恢复能力，可在回退后继续输入新提示词，并在需要时回滚到对应阶段的工作区文件。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin adds timeline-based conversation rewind and restore actions, supports continuing from a rewinded state with new prompts, and can rollback workspace files to the chosen checkpoint.

capabilities: Provides timeline- and message-level conversation rewind and restore actions in the DeepSeek Harness web chat interface.
Implements branch-continue behavior where sending after rewind continues the selected path without a disruptive session switch.
Captures workspace snapshots per completed turn and can rollback project files to a selected checkpoint when continuing from rewind.
Uses background session fork/archive and checkpoint-switching flow to keep UI interaction responsive during recovery operations.

reasons.code: README states a timeline dialog, docked rollback bar, per-turn/message revert actions, and restore modes for conversations.
README states project files are rolled back only when new prompts are sent, based on `/dsh-rewind rollback`, with incremental snapshots stored by workspace.
package.json declares DSH web client integration for runtime, conversation UI, and layout modules, indicating UI/plugin-level behavior inside the chat application.
